rows.en: Captain, the ship will shortly be on course for atmospheric entry.
rows.notes: 本艦 -> 'the ship'. The ship is presumably the Nahel Argama (Bright, Torres, the ZZ crew).
uncertain: Ship not named in the line; inferred from the speakers.

rows.en: Understood. All hands, Level 2 battle stations... Keep the mobile suits ready to launch at any time.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'Level 2 battle stations'.
uncertain: Term: [jp] is not in the glossary. Chose 'Level 2 battle stations' (alternatives: 'Condition Two'). Other slices should use the same term.

rows.en: No way, seriously!? You're gonna send us out!?
rows.notes: [jp]: Elle is asking Bright (the one ordering) -> 'You're gonna send us out!?'

rows.en: The enemy we're chasing is planning to go down to Earth too, right!?
rows.notes: も = the enemy is heading to Earth just like the ship.

rows.en: That's right.
Then why now, of all times...
Now is precisely the time.
Yeah, yeah. A moment that feels bad to us feels just as bad to the enemy...
rows.notes: [jp] -> a bad moment for us.

rows.en: So that makes it our chance to strike.
Ooh, impressive. Spoken like a true ex-captain.
rows.notes: 元艦長さん: Beecha was formerly the Argama's acting captain (Gundam ZZ).

rows.en: Don't tease me. I'm just relieved that heavy load is finally off my shoulders.
Same goes for you guys, right, Torres?
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'you guys, ... Torres' (Torres and the others, including Saegusa who answers in 116).

rows.en: Honestly, when you were made captain, I wondered how it'd turn out... but we somehow made it out alive.
Looking back now, I'm grateful to you.
Yeah. You really did a great job.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'You really did a great job' (addressed to Beecha).

rows.en: Wh-why, it was nothing, really...
It seems my judgment was not mistaken after all...
By the way, Bright, does this mean you can stay on as captain full-time now?
rows.notes: ブライトさん rendered as plain 'Bright' (no honorific), as is usual in English Gundam translations. Same in rows 132 and 152.
uncertain: Honorific choice: ブライトさん -> 'Bright' (could be 'Captain Bright'/'Mr. Bright'). This should be kept consistent across slices.

rows.en: Yes. The postwar negotiations with the Baam side have settled down for now.
rows.notes: バーム側 -> 'the Baam side'.

rows.en: Besides... frankly, I'd rather sit here than deal with the bigwigs.
So what's going to happen to Little Baam in the end?
uncertain: Name: 小バーム is not in the glossary and not in the local akurasu dump; neo-akurasu was unreachable (502). Used 'Little Baam' (English Wikipedia's Tosho Daimos article). Please add it to the glossary. Same in rows 129 and 142.

rows.en: Led by Erika, leader of the Baam peace faction...
rows.notes: エリカ君 -> 'Erika' (the glossary says female; no pronoun used).

rows.en: ...it will move from the Moon to the Mars sphere until things in the Earth Sphere settle down.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'from the Moon to the Mars sphere'. 地球圏 -> 'Earth Sphere'.
uncertain: The subject of row 124 (Little Baam / its people) carries over from rows 122-123.

rows.en: Move? You mean with a Bison Jump?
rows.notes: Mondo garbles [jp] as [jp]; rendered as the English mishearing 'Bison Jump', and Iino corrects him in row 126.
uncertain: Malapropism: 'Bison Jump' is my localisation of [jp] (literally 'Basun').

rows.en: It's Boson Jump. Boson Jump.
Oh, right, that. Are they gonna use that Boson Jump?
rows.notes: Implied subject 'they' = Little Baam / the Baam.

rows.en: What are you talking about? Something that huge can't fit through a Chulip.
rows.notes: [jp] = Little Baam. チューリップ = Chulip (glossary/decisions).

rows.en: Besides, Little Baam has a warp drive built in.
rows.notes: ワープ装置 -> 'warp drive'.

rows.en: Ahh, I get it. No wonder it suddenly showed up right near the Moon at the start.
rows.notes: な～る -> 'Ahh, I get it'.
uncertain: 最初に is read as 'at the start' (when Little Baam first appeared in the story).

rows.en: You're only figuring that out now?
Bright, the results of Ple and Ple Two's checkups are in.
rows.notes: Ple / Ple Two per the glossary (not 'Puru').

rows.en: How did they turn out?
Nothing's wrong with them. They say there's no need to move them to the hospital on La Vie en Rose.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'the hospital on La Vie en Rose' (the supply ship).
uncertain: Kept omission: 'They say' stands in for the unnamed source of the medical opinion (～そうです).

rows.en: I see... That battle cost us a great deal, but...
At least we were able to save those kids. That's some consolation.
rows.notes: あの子達 -> 'those kids' (gender-neutral, true to the source).

rows.en: Yes...
And what about Judau?
He was overjoyed about Ple and Ple Two, but... I guess he's still...
rows.notes: [jp]… left trailing.
uncertain: Kept omission: Leina breaks off ('he's still...'), implying Judau still hasn't recovered or is still down. The trailing-off is kept on purpose.

rows.en: No wonder. He's the one who was worn down most by the fight with Haman Karn...
rows.notes: 無理もない -> 'No wonder'. [jp] -> 'Haman Karn' (full name, as in the source).

rows.en: Yeah...
rows.notes: Iino answers Bright's remark.

rows.en: Before the battle to liberate Little Baam, when the Federation and Neo Zeon called a truce...
rows.notes: Leads into row 143, where the subject 'he' = Judau (あいつ).
uncertain: [jp] -> 'the battle to liberate Little Baam' (event name not in the glossary).

rows.en: ...he was so happy, thinking the fighting might finally be over.
Yeah. But... in the end, Haman and Glemy still came after us...
rows.notes: 仕掛けてきた -> 'came after us'.

rows.en: And after that, Giganos declares war, right? Anybody would be fed up, not just Judau.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'not just Judau'.

rows.en: It's nothing new, but the Federation brass really do work people to the bone, don't they?
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'the Federation brass'.

rows.en: Tell me about it. Ordering us down to Earth to escort a new-weapons transport unit...
rows.notes: Implied subject 'us' (the crew) for the escort order.

rows.en: So it's settled. We're definitely getting dragged into the war with Giganos for real now.
Don't complain. You must have known it would come to this sooner or later.
Well, that's true, but...
Besides, other Federation units are being thrown into the Giganos war one after another too. We are all in the same boat.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'We are all in the same boat.'

rows.en: Bright, isn't the Nadesico going to help us out?
They're away from the Earth Sphere on a separate mission. They likely won't join the Giganos war until later.
rows.notes: だろう -> 'likely'.

rows.en: I see...
If I remember right, the Nadesico's former captain... passed away, right...?
rows.notes: [jp] = the Nadesico's former captain (in canon Yurika Misumaru, presumed dead in Prince of Darkness). Roux does not name them, so I added no name and no pronoun.
uncertain: Gender: the source gives none; I avoided a pronoun. Ending 'passed away, right...?' for ～のよね…

rows.en: Yeah. For a while there were rumors that it was the Titans' doing.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'the Titans' doing'.

rows.en: During the Lizard War, it seems the Nadesico earned quite a grudge from those guys.
rows.notes: あいつら = the Titans (row 156). 蜥蜴戦争 -> 'Lizard War' (glossary: Lizard War (Jovian War)).
uncertain: Referent: 'those guys' = the Titans (inferred from row 156).

rows.en: But then the Titans themselves were wiped out in the Gryps Conflict...
uncertain: Name: the source says グリプス戦争 (Gryps War); the glossary entry is グリプス戦役 = 'Gryps Conflict'. I used 'Gryps Conflict' for consistency. Please confirm.

rows.en: So in the end, the word is that the Nadesico captain's death was probably just an accident.
rows.notes: という話だ -> 'the word is'.

uncertain: Rendered the source's long silence as '...'.

rows.en: Still, those Giganos guys... When did they manage to get that much military strength ready?
The lunar cities that preceded the Giganos Empire had a great many Metal Worker plants.
They used them to mass-produce Metal Armor while the Baam and Neo Zeon wars were going on.
So basically, they just sat back and grabbed the best part for themselves?
uncertain: Free rendering of oishii toko-dori (reaping the gains while others fight); Bright's 'No' in 165 confirms the sense.

rows.en: No. Even before declaring independence, Giganos was allied with the Neo Zeon forces and aiding them.
On top of that, when the Neo Zeon forces descended to Earth a few months ago...
I hear Giganos sent a Metal Armor unit down along with them.
But the bigger problem than that is...
The mass driver, right?
Yes. It takes far less effort than a colony drop... and yet it can instill the same level of fear in the Federation.
Furthermore, the leader of Giganos, Marshal Guiltorre...
is a man who warned that the Federation's Earth supremacism was destroying Earth's environment.
uncertain: Continues Bright's sentence from 171, so it starts lowercase with no subject restated; 'Earth supremacism' for chikyuu shijou shugi is my own rendering, not in the glossary.

rows.en: And he sees Earth as a sanctuary that must be protected... He is proclaiming that Ereism is in peril.
uncertain: Name question: エレズム is not in the glossary. Used 'Ereism' (the Gundam UC romanization I found on a wiki via search). Alternative spelling: 'Elezm'. Not checked on akurasu.net.

rows.en: And if Neo Zeon remnants or the hawks exiled from Mokuren were to side with him...
uncertain: Used 'Mokuren' (short form of the glossary's 'Mokuren (Jovian Federation)'). Inferred that 'him' is Guiltorre (source: 'side with' has no stated object).

rows.en: this war will be a repeat of the Lizard War and the Gryps Conflict.
uncertain: Continues 174, so it starts lowercase. Source says グリプス戦争 (War); I used the glossary's 'Gryps Conflict' (its entry is for グリプス戦役) to stay consistent. Used 'Lizard War' from the glossary's 'Lizard War (Jovian War)'.

rows.en: Captain, enemy readings ahead on our course!
Good, we've caught up to them! All hands, Level 1 battle stations! Mobile suit teams, launch at once!
uncertain: Read dai-1-shu sentou haichi as 'Level 1 battle stations'. Inferred that 'them' is the enemy reported in 177.

rows.en: Roger!
Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: 覚えていろ rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: 頼んだぜ: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: 大佐 = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: ここまで: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: なんという… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. Allied mothership is shot down.
rows.notes: Player; defeat objective; allied carrier condition. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: The enemy ship appears to have launched its Metal Armor squadron!
rows.notes: Torres to Bright; urgent bridge report; enemy launch triggers deployment. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: Maintain this course! Mobile suit team, launch!
rows.notes: Bright to bridge and pilots; command; reply to 2. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: Everyone, listen up! If we don't finish this quickly, we'll throw off the Nahel Argama's reentry timing, too!
rows.notes: Beecha to Gundam Team; urgent reminder; reentry plan in preceding scene. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: Yes, I know!
rows.notes: Roux to Beecha; brisk acknowledgement; reply to 4. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.
Judau to team; silence; preceding scene establishes war exhaustion. Decision: Retained intentional silence; no omitted grammatical proposition. Retained source fragment: Intentional silence.

rows.en: Judau, are you listening!?
rows.notes: Beecha to Judau; insistent check; replies to 6. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: ...Yeah.
rows.notes: Judau to Beecha; subdued answer; reply to 7. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: Are you sure you're all right, Judau...?
rows.notes: Iino to Judau; concerned; response to distracted acknowledgement. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: Don't worry, Iino. If fighting has to break out, I'll put an end to it as fast as I can...
rows.notes: Judau to Iino; reassurance and resolve; unavoidable fighting is conditional. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: That's all I can do right now.
rows.notes: Judau to team; sober resolve; explanation of 10. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: So I'll give it one more push in this Double Zeta, for Leina and everyone else.
rows.notes: Judau to team; determined; Double Zeta action for Leina and others. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: Judau...
rows.notes: Roux to Judau; moved name call; responds to 12. Decision: Retained intentional name call. Retained source fragment: Intentional name call.

rows.en: Looks like he's going to be all right now.
rows.notes: Beecha privately; relieved assessment; Judau is explicit referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: Anyway, Ple, Ple Two... Are you two really okay with this?
rows.notes: Judau to Ple and Ple Two; concern; asks consent to fighting. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: Yeah. It's our turn to help you and the others, Judau. Right, Ple Two?
rows.notes: Ple to Judau then Ple Two; cheerful support; allies helped them before. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: Yes... I'll fight to atone for everything I've done, too.
rows.notes: Ple Two to Judau; sober atonement; reply to 15-16. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: All right...! Everyone, keep your guard up!
rows.notes: Beecha to Gundam Team; rallying warning; resumes deployment. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: Captain! As we suspected, the enemy is the Gundam Team!
rows.notes: Karl to Meio; formal urgent report; identifies enemy team. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: They're the ones who played the leading role in defeating Haman Karn...
rows.notes: Meio to squad; recognizing formidable opponents; identifies Haman victors. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary. Meaning review: Restored they are rather than retaining a recognition noun fragment. Root confirmed Haman Karn from existing glossary notes.

rows.en: So they're the ones pursuing us... It seems the Federation Forces are finally getting serious.
rows.notes: Meio to squad; wary assessment; Federation pursuit explained by 20. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: Judging by their mothership's course, I believe they intend to join the fleet transporting the D-Weapons at sea.
rows.notes: Dan to Meio; formal tactical analysis; carrier course indicates sea transport fleet. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: So they're heading for the same destination as we are.
rows.notes: Meio to Dan/squad; realizes shared destination; answers 22. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

And there's no guarantee Medius will turn up wherever this ship goes...

rows.en: That wouldn't explain why they only stole Medius Locus.

rows.notes: Listener: self. Leads discussing their reassignment and the Medius theft; wary, analytical reply to adjacent line.

rows.en: But that's impossible... That person... couldn't have come back...

rows.en: ..."Operation Overlord"... So the Federation is finally going to strike back at them?
uncertain: Restored the subject as 'the Federation' (source has none). Inferred that 'them' is Giganos from the earlier scene; the source only says 彼ら.

rows.en: Yes. And in connection with it, the Federation forces have sent me a request for support.
By support, you mean... Getter Robo?
No, not only that.
My Saotome Institute, your Institute of Space Science, Genzo Umon...
rows.notes: Campaign assembly reconciles legacy spelling to name_fixes.json; original prologue retained.

rows.en: And the Photon Power Laboratory, Mutropolis, the Science Fortress Laboratory and others...
They have asked the institutes involved with super robots to work together more closely than ever and assist the military.
uncertain: Added 'They have asked' to match the source's passive 'a request came'. 特機 is not in the glossary; I used 'super robots'.
Rendered the source's long silence as '...'.

rows.en: And the one behind this call is Commander Koichiro Misumaru of the Federation Space Force...
uncertain: 司令 rendered as 'Commander'. Federation Space Force (連邦宇宙軍) is not in the glossary.

rows.en: Surely you've heard his name too, Doctor?
Yes.
To deal with the fight against the Giganos forces and what lies ahead, Operation Overlord included...
Commander Misumaru is planning to form a new super robot unit centered on the Nahel Argama and Nadesico B.
uncertain: 特機部隊 rendered as 'super robot unit'.

rows.en: I see... In the Baam War and the Devil Gundam incident, their teamwork was a major key to resolving things.
uncertain: Inferred referent: 'their teamwork' (彼らの連携) means the cooperation between the super robot groups and ships just named. The source leaves this open.

rows.en: On my end, too, the battles with the Dinosaur Empire, the Mycenae Empire and the Demon Empire are over...
uncertain: Ends with '...' and runs on into 195, which starts with 'So'.

rows.en: So I intend to send the Getter Team to that super robot unit as soon as the new Getter Robo is completed.
...Understood. We too will offer you whatever cooperation we can.
I'm grateful. Please do.
uncertain: Direction for お願いします: Saotome is asking Umon to follow through on his offer of help, so I wrote 'I'm grateful. Please do.'

rows.en: One more thing... Lately, those UFOs have been appearing more and more often.
uncertain: 例のUFO rendered as 'those UFOs' (the ones both scientists already know about).

rows.en: I think it would be wise for you to stay fully on your guard over there as well.
Understood. Well then...
...Operation Overlord, and the founding of a super robot unit...
It's true we must get ourselves ready before they make any concrete move, but...
uncertain: Kept the source's 'they' (彼ら) unresolved. From context it is probably the UFO aliens (or possibly the Federation); Umon's thought does not say.

rows.en: Hello, Genzo Umon. I'm Koji Kabuto.
rows.notes: Campaign assembly reconciles legacy spelling to name_fixes.json; original prologue retained.

rows.en: Oh, I'm glad you came, Koji. Has it been about a year since you were last in Japan?
No... Actually, I came back once about six months ago.
I came to help Ryo, Akira and the others fight the Dinosaur Empire and the Demon Empire.
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Restored 'I came' to finish the sentence begun in 205. リョウ君 = Ryoma (glossary en_short) and 洸 = Akira (Hibiki, glossary).

rows.en: But your Mazinger Z, if I recall...
uncertain: Kept Umon's trailing-off line as it is in the source.

rows.en: That time was a special case. It's back in the Robot Museum now.
I see. By the way, that TFO you flew here in... It's quite well made.
Thank you. That saucer is the fruit of my studies in America.
Because of it, though, the folks at Shirakaba Ranch mistook me for a UFO.
uncertain: The source is passive ('I was mistaken for a UFO'); kept 'mistook me', meaning Koji in his saucer.

rows.en: Danbei, eh... He's quite the UFO researcher, you know.
uncertain: 団兵衛さん rendered as 'Danbei' (glossary en_short); the honorific was dropped.

rows.en: He seems a little worked up over all the UFO sightings lately.
That's just it, Doctor. The reason I came here is...
I wanted to hear about the UFOs that have been appearing lately around this Institute of Space Science and TOKYO JUPITER.
I don't mind, but... What for?
Well... Actually, I'd like to try making contact with them.
Contact...?
Yes. Many people on Earth feel prejudice and fear toward aliens.
But I want to believe that we can come to understand them through peaceful talks.
And I think that from now on, Earth should actively engage with other planets.
But that will be a difficult thing, Koji.
I know.
Can humanity, still fighting among itself, deal peacefully with other planets...? Honestly, I have my doubts too.
But we have a wonderful precedent: we succeeded in making peace with the Baam.
I'm never going to give up.
I see...
If only the alien peoples we are going to meet thought the way you do...
uncertain: Restored 'we' as the subject (meaning humanity).

rows.en: Father!
uncertain: 父さん rendered as 'Father' to match Daisuke's polite register.

rows.en: What is it, Daisuke?
There's something I need to talk to you about...
Before that, let me introduce you. This is Koji Kabuto...
The pilot of Mazinger Z, who helped bring down Dr. Hell and the Mycenae Empire.
Never mind that. I have something important to tell you.
uncertain: Free rendering of それより ('Never mind that').

rows.en: Hey, hey, so you're just gonna ignore me!?
Daisuke, you're being rude to Koji.
This is no time for that. Father... Have you seen the moon?
No... At this hour, it should have only just risen... Wait, Daisuke. Don't tell me the moon's color is...!?
Yes. It's glowing a fiery red.
uncertain: The source has no subject; restored 'It' (the moon), which 238 settles.

rows.en: What...?!
The moon...? What about the moon?
A red moon... the signal fire for their sortie. ...You should contact the Earth Federation Forces. They will attack, without a doubt.
uncertain: 'You should contact' - Daisuke is addressing his father (row 238-241 exchange); 'they' (奴ら) is left unnamed as in the source.

rows.en: Them? Attack? What on earth are you talking about?
...You'd better stay out of this one. If you underestimate them, you'll get hurt.
They're nothing like the enemies you once fought in Mazinger Z.
What...?! What's that supposed to mean?
That's enough, Daisuke.
...Koji, you must be tired from your long journey. Please, get some rest today.
Y-yes, sir...
Daisuke Umon... Just who is this guy...?
So the time has finally come... But I don't want to pilot it... not that thing, ever again...
uncertain: あんな物 ('that thing') left unnamed as in the source (it is Grendizer, not yet revealed).

rows.en: I don't want to pilot that thing ever again...!

rows.en: Now, let's see what #機体名 can do!
rows.notes: Conditional combat quote; adversary requests display of lead unit's power.

rows.en: Are those bastards going after the institute!?
rows.notes: Koji sees aliens target institute; inference retained as question.

rows.en: If only we could use it at a time like this...!
rows.notes: Umon wishes Grendizer could be deployed; we is institution/Daisuke side, machine remains unrevealed it.

rows.en: But first, that boy must decide to fight of his own free will...!
rows.notes: Umon knows Daisuke must choose voluntarily; that boy matches parental view.

rows.en: Duuuke Fleeed!!
rows.notes: Daisuke transformation/identity shout; elongated call retained without changing name spelling elsewhere.

rows.en: Grendizer, gooo!!
rows.notes: Duke launch command; elongated go shout.

rows.en: Wh-what!?
rows.notes: Koji reacts to Grendizer appearance; startled question.

rows.en: Hm!? Th-that's...!!
rows.notes: Blacky recognizes machine but has not completed identification; deliberate interruption.

rows.en: Shoot In!!
rows.notes: Duke cockpit-transfer call; literal launch phrase. Root supplied corroboration for distinctive launch call; preserve.

rows.en: Dizer, gooo!!
rows.notes: Duke launch command using shortened Dizer; source short call retained. Root supplied corroboration for distinctive launch call; preserve.

rows.en: Daisuke...!
rows.notes: Umon's emotional name call to Daisuke; vocative fragment.

rows.en: Koji, are you all right!?
rows.notes: Duke checks Koji's safety after intervening.

rows.en: How do you know my name...!?
rows.notes: Koji asks Duke how he knows Koji's name; explicit verb restored despite trailing source.

rows.en: No, never mind that! What is that robot!? Just who the hell are you!?
rows.notes: Koji shifts priority to mysterious robot and pilot; forceful spoken question.

rows.en: There's no time to explain! Let's take them down first!
rows.notes: Duke tells Koji to attack first and postpones explanation; collective action explicit.

rows.en: Th-that's Grendizer, without a doubt...!
rows.notes: Blacky identifies Grendizer; stammer retained.

rows.en: Damn you, Duke Fleed! So you fled to this planet...!? Grr, deploy the Saucer Beasts!
rows.notes: Blacky realizes Duke fled here; orders Saucer Beast deployment.

rows.en: ! They've got weapons like Mechanical Beasts and Warrior Beasts too!?
rows.notes: Koji compares Saucer Beasts to familiar enemy weapons; glossary classes retained.

rows.en: Listen well, you devils! Grendizer has returned!
rows.notes: Duke addresses Vegan enemies; Grendizer's return declared.

rows.en: To protect this beautiful green Earth from your evil clutches!!
rows.notes: Purpose clause continues previous row, deliberately not independent sentence.

rows.en: D-damn it...! I never expected to find him here...!
rows.notes: Blacky did not anticipate Duke's presence; sourced Duke gender.

rows.en: I'll head back and report this to Commander Gandal! I'm leaving the rest to you!
rows.notes: Blacky retreats to report to Commander Gandal and entrusts remainder to subordinates; direction retained.

rows.en: That bastard's running away!?
rows.notes: Koji notices Blacky fleeing; insult retained.

rows.en: Koji, focus on the enemies in front of us for now!
rows.notes: Duke tells Koji to focus on immediate foes instead of pursuit.

rows.en: Y-yeah!
rows.notes: Koji acknowledges Duke's order; stammer.

rows.en: That seems to be all of them... Are you all right, Koji?
rows.notes: After enemy defeat, Duke checks Koji; battle result then safety.

rows.en: That voice, those eyes... Could you be...?
rows.notes: Koji begins to recognize Daisuke by voice/eyes; unfinished identity question retained.

rows.en: Be careful, both of you! An unidentified flying object is heading this way!
rows.notes: Umon alerts both pilots to approaching unidentified craft.

rows.en: ! Another UFO!?
rows.notes: Koji reacts to another UFO; exclamation leading source marker.

rows.en: What the hell is that robot...!?
rows.notes: Koji questions unfamiliar robot; natural forceful wording.

rows.en: At least it isn't with the Vegan Empire forces...
rows.notes: Duke distinguishes arrival from Vegan attackers; subject restored as it.

rows.en: Major, this is the area where the fighting was taking place a moment ago.
rows.notes: Hidden operator reports location to Major; formal report.

rows.en: What is that machine? It looks like a super robot, but...
rows.notes: Hidden Major asks about Grendizer; super robot follows project prologue tokki usage and root terminology decision.

rows.en: ...I have no matching data. What's more, I'm detecting an unknown energy signature.
rows.notes: Hidden operator reports unavailable matching data and unfamiliar energy.

rows.en: Hmph... So that's why you stopped here instead of our destination, the Saotome Institute.
rows.notes: Hidden Major infers why operator diverted to institute from Saotome destination.

rows.en: Yes. Besides, if we put them in contact with the people at the Institute of Space Science...
rows.notes: Hidden operator proposes placing pursuing protagonists in contact with Institute staff; unfinished condition continues next row.

rows.en: I believe that will ultimately accomplish our primary objective.
rows.notes: Hidden operator completes previous condition with primary-objective conclusion; explicit I believe.

rows.en: What makes you think so?
rows.notes: Major asks operator to justify proposed conclusion; full verb question.

rows.en: That institute has close ties to other super robot bases.
rows.notes: Operator cites Institute connections to other super robot bases; project terminology confirmed by root.

rows.en: Through those connections, I expect they'll eventually meet up with the Nahel Argama and Nadesico B...
rows.notes: Operator expects pursuers to connect with ships through Institute network; they restored, no gender.

rows.en: Very well... Then let's teach AI1 how terrifying real combat can be.
rows.notes: Major accepts diversion and plans AI1 combat lesson; explicit collective instruction.

rows.en: Terrifying...?
rows.notes: Operator questions Major's fear concept; deliberate echo fragment.

rows.en: This child has no need for emotions.
rows.notes: Operator treats AI1 as child and rejects emotional need; explicit subject, no AI gender.

rows.en: We've also been ordered to shoot you down. Using that machine as a shield won't save you!
rows.notes: Male lead warns the thief after the female lead demands the stolen machine back; machine as shield retained.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... It seems you've made it back into action.
rows.notes: Hidden opponent thinks about the male lead's return; subject inferred from his threat.
uncertain: Return to action is inferred to refer to the male lead from the preceding threat; hidden speaker remains ???.

rows.en: ...Disable the weapon safeties.
rows.notes: Male lead orders copilot after the enemy fails to respond; imperative direction preserved.

rows.en: Shouldn't we contact that institute...?!
rows.notes: Female lead questions proceeding without notifying local institute.

rows.en: No need. Our machine is classified.
rows.notes: Male lead answers copilot's question; explicit no need avoids inverted yes/no.

rows.en: I think that stopped meaning anything the moment we rushed out after Medius...
rows.notes: Female lead challenges secrecy rationale, referring to their public pursuit.

rows.en: Just concentrate on adjusting the power output.
rows.notes: Male lead cuts off objection and assigns copilot's task.

rows.en: Our #機体名 can't beat that thing in a race. We have to make sure we finish it off here.
rows.notes: Male lead explains their speed disadvantage; enemy machine referred to neutrally.

rows.en: I-I know that!
rows.notes: Female lead objects to being lectured; stutter retained.

rows.en: Yes. I'm beginning data collection... I'll leave the fighting to you, Major.
rows.notes: Hidden copilot answers hidden pilot's preparation question; source Major address retained despite following rejection.

rows.en: Leave the fighting to me. You just need to adjust the power output.
rows.notes: Male lead reassures copilot struggling with output and enemy-pattern calculations.

rows.en: No way! I'll show you I can handle my other duties properly, too!
rows.notes: Female lead insists on proving herself beyond power adjustment.

rows.en: Damn that Medius! It's so fast...!
rows.notes: Male lead reacts to enemy's escape speed.

rows.en: There's no point saying that now. We're going after it.
rows.notes: Male lead answers explanation that Medius lacks a TE engine; pursuit subject restored.

rows.en: Wait, #男愛称! We've got new orders!
rows.notes: Female lead stops pursuit on receipt of command update.

rows.en: I don't even need to read them. They say to pursue Medius at once, right?
rows.notes: Male lead assumes update repeats pursuit orders.

rows.en: W-well... That's not what they say.
rows.notes: Female lead corrects his assumption; stutter retained.

rows.en: It's not? What do you mean?
rows.notes: Male lead asks about contradictory orders.

rows.en: The orders say... Join the Space Force battleship Nahel Argama along with the super robots in the Japan region, and...
rows.notes: Female lead reads command text; sentence continues in next row, full unit and region details retained.

rows.en: Continue the mission to pursue Medius Locus. ...What is this supposed to mean...?
rows.notes: Female lead finishes quoted command then questions it; row boundary retained.

rows.en: That's practically telling us to let Medius get away...!
rows.notes: Female lead interprets delay caused by rendezvous order.

rows.en: ...#女愛称, contact that institute. If these orders are real, they should have been told about them, too.
rows.notes: Male lead seeks confirmation from institute; listener instruction and third-party notification kept distinct.

rows.en: O-okay...
rows.notes: Female lead agrees to make contact.

rows.en: ...Tell me, Daisuke. The one piloting that Grendizer was...
rows.notes: Koji asks Daisuke about pilot identity and trails off deliberately.

rows.en: Koji, it seems I couldn't fool your eyes...
rows.notes: Daisuke admits Koji recognized him as pilot.

rows.en: Then... It really was you piloting it?
rows.notes: Koji confirms implied action explicitly.

rows.en: Yes, it was.
rows.notes: Daisuke answers Koji's pilot question with restored referent.

rows.en: Koji, Daisuke isn't my biological son.
rows.notes: Umon begins revelation; biological relationship explicit.

rows.en: He's the prince of Planet Fleed in the Vega Nebula... His real name is Duke Fleed.
rows.notes: Umon reveals origin and identity; male gender is sourced in glossary.
uncertain: Vega Nebula is a faithful literal of the fictional source setting; root found no Akurasu entry or independently established canonical English form.

rows.en: The prince of Planet Fleed... Duke Fleed...
rows.notes: Koji repeats revelation in disbelief; deliberate nominal echo retained.

rows.en: His world was peaceful and scientifically advanced. But then...
rows.notes: Umon sets up Fleed's destruction; trailing contrast retained.

rows.en: One day, King Vega turned on Planet Fleed, seeking to conquer the entire Vega Nebula.
rows.notes: Daisuke explains invasion motive and target.
uncertain: Vega Nebula is a faithful literal of the fictional source setting; root found no Akurasu entry or independently established canonical English form.

rows.en: Innocent people were killed one after another, and merciless flames consumed the green land.
rows.notes: Daisuke recounts slaughter without softening; passive preserves source focus on victims.

rows.en: And in the blazing palace, my father, my mother, and my sister...
rows.notes: Daisuke cannot finish describing family's fate; no death verb invented.

rows.en: ...Then what exactly is Grendizer...?
rows.notes: Koji changes question after silence; verb restored.

rows.en: It's a robot my father had built with the finest science on Planet Fleed to protect peace throughout the universe.
rows.notes: Daisuke explains Grendizer's origin and purpose; commissioned construction explicit.

rows.en: But King Vega saw Grendizer's power... and tried to use it to conquer the universe...
rows.notes: Daisuke explains why robot became invasion target.

rows.en: So, no matter what happened, I couldn't let Grendizer fall into his hands...
rows.notes: Daisuke states refusal to let Vega obtain robot.

rows.en: Then I escaped Planet Fleed with Grendizer.
rows.notes: Daisuke continues escape account; subject restored.

rows.en: Grendizer drifted through endless space and reached a beautiful planet shining blue.
rows.notes: Daisuke describes arrival at Earth; robot remains subject.

rows.en: ...That planet was Earth.
rows.notes: Daisuke identifies planet explicitly.

rows.en: Later, by chance, I found Grendizer after it crash-landed in the Yatsugatake Mountains, along with...
rows.notes: Umon recounts discovery; sentence continues across row boundary. Yatsugatake Mountains confirmed by root against official JNTO; canonical capitalization applied after drafting.

rows.en: Duke Fleed, who was barely alive.
rows.notes: Umon finishes discovery sentence from prior row; predicate connection retained.

rows.en: That was how we met, bound together by a mysterious thread of fate.
rows.notes: Umon describes fateful meeting metaphor naturally.

rows.en: And then you took Daisuke in as your own son, Doctor...
rows.notes: Koji infers adoption; omitted action restored from revelation.

rows.en: Yes. That was nearly two years ago now.
rows.notes: Umon confirms adoption and time since meeting.

rows.en: I see...
rows.notes: Koji acknowledges account.

rows.en: I've made you relive a painful past, Daisuke...
rows.notes: Umon regrets asking Daisuke to remember trauma.

rows.en: It's all right, Father.
rows.notes: Daisuke reassures adoptive father.

rows.en: Koji... I'm sorry to ask, but could you keep this a secret between us for a while?
rows.notes: Umon asks Koji to preserve identity secret; request direction explicit.

rows.en: If Daisuke's identity becomes public, it could lead to needless misunderstandings...
rows.notes: Umon gives reason for secrecy.

rows.en: Yes, I understand.
rows.notes: Koji accepts secrecy request.

rows.en: More to the point... What matters is what happens next.
rows.notes: Daisuke redirects discussion toward future danger.

rows.en: King Vega of the Vegan Empire forces never lets his prey escape. They'll certainly return to this beautiful Earth...
rows.notes: Daisuke warns Vega will invade again; proper organization term retained.

rows.en: About that... I hear the Vegan Empire forces attacked Saotome Institute at almost the same time they attacked us.
rows.notes: Umon reports parallel attack; both timing and attackers restored.

rows.en: Really?! Then what happened to Ryo and the others...?!
rows.notes: Koji asks about Getter team's safety; omitted question action restored.

rows.en: ...We haven't received a detailed report yet.
rows.notes: Umon answers that full team status is unavailable.

rows.en: For now, the institute itself seems to be safe, but...
rows.notes: Umon distinguishes institute safety from unknown personnel status.

rows.en: Knowing those guys, I want to believe they're all right...!
rows.notes: Koji hopes Getter team survived; personal wish preserved.

rows.en: ...As I thought, this won't be a problem for us alone.
rows.notes: Daisuke concludes attacks affect more than their own group.

rows.en: Yes. With that in mind, to deal with the various situations ahead, the Federation Forces...
rows.notes: Umon introduces forthcoming unit formation; subject and clause carried to next row.

rows.en: Are going to establish a new super robot unit.
rows.notes: Umon completes preceding subject; cross-row sentence retained.

rows.en: A super robot unit...?
rows.notes: Koji echoes unfamiliar proposal; intentional question fragment.

rows.en: Yes. Soon, descending into the Japan region...
rows.notes: Umon starts description of arriving battleship; unfinished syntactic lead-in retained.

rows.en: The Federation Space Force battleship Nahel Argama will form the core of an independent unit, I'm told.
rows.notes: Umon supplies battleship subject and organizational role from preceding row.

rows.en: Nahel Argama... That's the Gundam Team's mothership, the one that did so well in the recent Neo Zeon conflict, right?
rows.notes: Koji recognizes ship by prior war accomplishments.

rows.en: That's right. Besides the Gundam Team, various other forces will gather aboard that ship.
rows.notes: Umon explains coalition aboard ship.

rows.en: So, I'd like you both to go to Nahel Argama, too...
rows.notes: Umon asks Koji and Daisuke to join ship; request direction explicit.

rows.en: Does that mean... You want us to join the military?
rows.notes: Daisuke asks whether request means enlistment.

rows.en: No, that's not it. You'll be treated as civilian collaborators.
rows.notes: Umon clarifies their civilian status.

rows.en: ...I'm fine with that.
rows.notes: Koji accepts joining as civilian.

rows.en: Since the Vegan Empire forces mean to invade, we have to defend Earth against them...
rows.notes: Koji gives reason for cooperation; invade and defend subjects explicit.

rows.en: And we can't just ignore Giganos or TOKYO JUPITER, either.
rows.notes: Koji adds other threats; fixed glossary spelling retained.

rows.en: ...I'm sorry, Koji. I've ended up sending you back to the battlefield...
rows.notes: Umon regrets consequence of request.

rows.en: It's all right. That was part of why I came back to Japan in the first place.
rows.notes: Koji reassures Umon that combat was an original motive.

rows.en: ...What about you, Daisuke?
rows.notes: Umon asks Daisuke whether he will cooperate.

rows.en: ...The Vegan Empire forces aren't the only aliens targeting this planet...
rows.notes: Daisuke hints at another alien threat.

rows.en: If the rumors I heard before coming to Earth are true, they, too...
rows.notes: Daisuke deliberately leaves unknown aliens' action unfinished; no gender or identity invented.
uncertain: They refers to unnamed alien forces; source deliberately withholds identity and action.

rows.en: Daisuke, you...
rows.notes: Koji reacts to Daisuke's hesitation with an unfinished address.

rows.en: ...No, I understand, Koji.
rows.notes: Daisuke stops dwelling on other threats and acknowledges his responsibility, explicit in following rows.

rows.en: Now that I've boarded Grendizer again, I can't escape my destiny.
rows.notes: Daisuke to Genzo/Koji; solemn acceptance; Grendizer's return commits him to fate. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: Besides... Earth is my second home.
rows.notes: Daisuke to Genzo/Koji; heartfelt explanation; Earth is adopted home. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: For this planet's beautiful greenery and the people who love it, I'll go with you, too.
rows.notes: Daisuke to Genzo/Koji; resolves to accompany allies; protects greenery and people. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: ...Then, I'm sorry to ask this so soon, but please head to the Saotome Institute with them.
rows.notes: Genzo to Daisuke/Koji; apologetic instruction; newly introduced pilots are them. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: Them? You mean the two from earlier...?
rows.notes: Koji to Genzo; questioning recognition; them refers to earlier pilots. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary. Retained source fragment/continuation: The two from earlier... is an intentional interrupted recognition question.

rows.en: Yes. Both of you, please come inside.
rows.notes: Genzo to lead pair; welcoming invitation; permits entry. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: ...I'm Second Lieutenant #女姓名, of the Federation Forces' Tsentr Project.
rows.notes: Female lead to group; formal introduction; project affiliation and rank. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: I'm Second Lieutenant #男姓名, also with the Federation Forces' Tsentr Project.
rows.notes: Male lead to group; curt matching introduction; same rank and affiliation as preceding female lead. Decision: Meaning review restores both Federation/Tsentr affiliation and rank in likewise; full name placeholder preserved.

rows.en: So you're both in the military. Oh, right, my name's...
rows.notes: Koji to lead pair; surprised friendly introduction; trails off at his name. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary. Retained source fragment/continuation: My name is... trails off before female lead supplies recognition.

rows.en: We know who you are. Koji Kabuto, right?
rows.notes: Female lead to Koji; polite recognition; identifies Koji Kabuto. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: Huh? You've heard of me?
rows.notes: Koji to female lead; surprised query; replies to recognition. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: Of course. You're famous as the pilot of Mazinger Z.
rows.notes: Female lead to Koji; warm recognition; Mazinger Z fame. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: You and the others have been featured on television and elsewhere many times, Koji.
rows.notes: Genzo to group; explanatory reassurance; Koji's group is known in media. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: So it's only natural that they'd know you.
rows.notes: Genzo to group; reasoned conclusion; replies to 492 by restoring knowing referent. Decision: Restored they would know you rather than vague obviousness; media-exposure context settles referent.

rows.en: At least among people involved in developing super robots, Koji Kabuto is a famous name.
rows.notes: Male lead to Koji/group; matter-of-fact; super-robot developers know Koji. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: Heh heh! Hearing you say that makes me feel kind of embarrassed.
rows.notes: Koji to male lead/group; bashful laugh; reacts to fame. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: ...By the way... If possible, could you tell me more about your situation?
rows.notes: Genzo to lead pair; tactful request; wants details of their circumstances. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: Yes, of course. Our superiors have given us permission, too.
rows.notes: Female lead to Genzo; permission acknowledgement; command authorized disclosure. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: From the look of it, your machine seems to be a super robot...
rows.notes: Genzo to lead pair; technical observation; their unit seems a super robot. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: Yes. Its name is #機体名...
rows.notes: Female lead to Genzo; affirmative identification; machine placeholder preserved. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary. Retained source fragment/continuation: Unit identification trails into following development/type description; no missing grammatical subject.

rows.en: It was developed under the Federation Forces' Tsentr Project...
rows.notes: Female lead to group; explains developer; continuation of machine description. Decision: Kept developed predicate without merging machine description across rows. Retained source fragment/continuation: Development description trails into next unit-type row; English retains subject/predicate.

rows.en: It's a humanoid mobile weapon powered by Terminus Energy... commonly known as a TE Absorber.
rows.notes: Female lead to group; technical report; humanoid weapon/energy/type. Decision: TE Absorber, Terminus Energy exact glossary spellings.

rows.en: A TE Absorber... And what is Terminus Energy?
rows.notes: Daisuke to female lead; asks definition; TE Absorber repeated as topic. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: It's an energy discovered by Dr. Mitar Zapat, the head of the Tsentr Project...
rows.notes: Female lead to Daisuke/group; defines energy discovery; Zapat heads project. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary. Retained source fragment/continuation: Energy definition trails into next scientific explanation; no dropped subject/action.

rows.en: Its existence was predicted in addition to the four forces: gravity, electromagnetism, the strong interaction, and the weak interaction.
rows.notes: Female lead to group; scientific explanation; fifth force beyond named four. Decision: All four forces retained; terminology uses strong/weak interaction rather than omitting explanatory list.

rows.en: Oh, I've heard about that... In theory, it exists everywhere, but it's incredibly hard to collect and use, right?
rows.notes: Koji to female lead; informed confirmation query; theoretical availability versus collection/use. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: ...You know a lot about it.
rows.notes: Male lead to Koji; impressed observation; Koji's technical knowledge. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: Well, I did all kinds of research in America.
rows.notes: Koji to male lead; casual explanation; research in America. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: But if it can use that Terminus Energy, does that mean #機体名 can operate indefinitely?
rows.notes: Koji to female lead; technical follow-up; indefinite operation inferred from energy. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: No. The TE Engine installed in it...
rows.notes: Female lead to Koji; denial then introduction of engine explanation; row continues. Decision: Retained deliberate engine-topic lead-in; next row supplies predicate. Retained source fragment/continuation: The TE Engine installed in it... is an intentional topic lead-in; next row supplies full predicate.

rows.en: The Terminus Energy Engine is still being adjusted, and its output isn't stable yet.
rows.notes: Female lead to Koji; output limits; engine still under adjustment. Decision: Terminus Energy Engine expands TE Engine using literal Japanese expansion; glossary TE Engine notes agree.

rows.en: Because of that, at present it still has to use electricity as auxiliary power...
rows.notes: Female lead to Koji; consequence; supplementary electric power. Decision: Restored machine subject it from technical context. Retained source fragment/continuation: Electrical auxiliary-power explanation trails into onboard-adjustment role; subject/predicate retained.

rows.en: That's why I have to be aboard to adjust the TE Engine's output.
rows.notes: Female lead to Koji; describes onboard role; she adjusts output. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: When you say adjust... does that have anything to do with that swimsuit-like outfit you're wearing, Lieutenant?
rows.notes: Koji to female lead; curious potentially embarrassing outfit question; rank as address. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: Y-yes... Well...
rows.notes: Female lead to Koji; embarrassed hesitant assent. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary. Retained source fragment/continuation: Hesitant assent and Well... remain intentional embarrassed speech.

rows.en: This outfit is necessary for Direct Feeling Control with the machine...
rows.notes: Female lead to Koji; explains control outfit; Direct Feeling Control exact glossary term. Decision: Control outfit purpose retained; exact glossary Direct Feeling Control. Retained source fragment/continuation: Control-clothing purpose trails into skin-exposure explanation; subject/predicate retained.

rows.en: So I have to leave my skin exposed...
rows.notes: Female lead to Koji; embarrassed explanation; bare skin required. Decision: Skin exposure explanation retained without softening. Retained source fragment/continuation: Skin-exposure explanation deliberately trails off; subject/predicate retained.

rows.en: ...Anyway, what about that black machine you were pursuing?
rows.notes: Daisuke to lead pair; changes topic; asks about black pursued unit. Decision: Restored what about for topic query while keeping machine referent.

rows.en: It's a prototype developed alongside ours in the Tsentr Project... Its name is Medius Locus.
rows.notes: Male lead to Daisuke; technical answer; parallel prototype Medius Locus. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: That machine doesn't have a TE Engine, but...
rows.notes: Female lead to Daisuke; contrast; Medius lacks TE Engine. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary. Retained source fragment/continuation: Contrast but... leads into replacement material in next row.

rows.en: Instead, Lasmunanium is used in its armor and frame.
rows.notes: Female lead to group; compensating technology; armor/frame material. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: Lasmunanium?
rows.notes: Daisuke to female lead; questioning material name repetition. Decision: Intentional questioning repetition of material name. Retained source fragment/continuation: Questioning repetition Lasmunanium? is intentional term echo, not omitted proposition.

rows.en: Like the TE Engine, Lasmunanium is a new material developed by Dr. Zapat...
rows.notes: Female lead to Daisuke; explains material origin; same developer as TE Engine. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary. Retained source fragment/continuation: Material-origin explanation trails into plain-language definition; subject/predicate retained.

rows.en: To put it simply, it's a metal that regenerates itself on its own.
rows.notes: Female lead to Daisuke; plain-language definition; autonomous regeneration. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: So it can repair its own damaged parts and stuff?
rows.notes: Koji to female lead; casual restatement; self-repair of damaged parts. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.

rows.en: Yes...
rows.notes: Female lead to Koji; assent. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary. Retained source fragment/continuation: Yes... is assent only.

rows.en: ...A power source that can theoretically operate indefinitely, and a self-regenerating material... Could it be...?
rows.notes: Genzo to group/self; synthesizes technologies; trails into conclusion next row. Decision: Intentional noun-list reflection and Could it be... trailing hypothesis; next row asks conclusion. Retained source fragment/continuation: Intentional noun-list reflection and Could it be... lead into goal question next row.

rows.en: Is the Tsentr Project's goal to develop mobile weapons that don't need maintenance?
rows.notes: Genzo to lead pair; asks goal; maintenance-free mobile weapon development. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary.
